title: Honeyed Jamaican Rice Pudding
description: A sweet, festive pudding that blends coconut, honey, and Jamaican spices in a stone bowl dolsot.
instructions: Rinse the uncooked rice until the water runs clear and soak it for 10 minutes.
Drain the rice and place it in a stone bowl dolsot with the measured water, then bring to a boil over medium heat.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer the rice for about 15 minutes until the water is absorbed.
Stir in the coconut milk, honey, nutmeg, cinnamon, vanilla extract, and a pinch of salt, then return the pot to low heat.
Cook the mixture, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes until it thickens to a creamy consistency.
Remove the dolsot from heat and let the pudding cool slightly so it thickens further as it rests.
Transfer the pudding to individual serving bowls and drizzle a thin layer of honey over each.
Dust the top of each bowl with icing sugar for a sweet finish.
Sprinkle chopped pistachios and shredded coconut over the surface for texture and flavor.
Serve warm or chilled, as preferred, and enjoy the aromatic Jamaican twist.
